CHAPTER 28  Medical Nutrition Therapy for Lower Gastrointestinal Tract Disorders
Absorption of fructose is improved when it is ingested with glucose 
(such as in sucrose) because glucose absorption stimulates path-
ways for fructose absorption. Although some degree of fructose 
malabsorption may be normal, those with coexisting GI disorders 
may be more likely to experience GI symptoms after fructose in-
gestion
